label: Demonstration data
title: Your sample network needs attention
lead: This interactive report uses fictional findings to show how the scanner turns technical observations into clear, practical review actions.

findings.title: Router administration needs review
findings.summary: The sample router exposes a high-priority administration concern.
findings.explanation: This fictional observation represents a router management configuration that should be reviewed by the owner.
findings.impact: A compromised router could weaken network protections and affect other devices.
actions: Open the router settings using its official app or local address.
Set a unique administrator passphrase.
Disable remote administration unless it is required.

findings.title: Legacy file-sharing service is enabled
findings.summary: An old file-sharing protocol could increase malware spread inside the home.
findings.explanation: This fictional observation represents an obsolete file-sharing protocol that should be disabled where it is not needed.
findings.impact: If one device becomes infected, legacy sharing may expose files or other computers.
actions: Confirm that no older device depends on the service.
Disable the legacy sharing feature.
Confirm normal file sharing still works.

findings.title: Router management uses unencrypted HTTP
findings.summary: Login details may be visible to another device on the local network.
findings.explanation: This fictional observation represents an administration page using HTTP rather than HTTPS.
findings.impact: A device already on the network could potentially observe or alter unprotected management traffic.
actions: Enable HTTPS administration if supported.
Use the HTTPS address for future administration.
Check for an official firmware update if HTTPS is unavailable.

findings.title: Security updates need review
findings.summary: The sample device may not contain recent security fixes.
findings.explanation: This fictional observation represents an operating-system build behind the demonstration dataset's update level.
findings.impact: Known weaknesses are easier to reuse when security updates are missing.
actions: Connect the laptop to power.
Install available security and cumulative updates.
Restart and check again until updates are current.

findings.title: Smart camera shares the main network
findings.summary: The fictional camera is shown beside laptops and phones.
findings.explanation: Smart devices often need internet access but rarely need direct access to personal computers.
findings.impact: Network separation can limit what a compromised camera reaches next.
actions: Create a guest or IoT Wi-Fi network.
Move smart devices to that network.
Enable client isolation if the router offers it.

findings.title: UPnP is enabled on the router
findings.summary: Apps and devices may open incoming ports automatically.
findings.explanation: This fictional observation represents Universal Plug and Play being enabled for convenience.
findings.impact: A compromised device could expose a service through automatic router changes.
actions: Review current port-forwarding rules.
Disable UPnP if trusted services continue to work.
Create only specific manual rules when needed.

findings.title: Printer settings need authentication
findings.summary: The sample printer console does not show an authentication prompt.
findings.explanation: This fictional observation represents an administrative page that should be protected.
findings.impact: A local visitor or compromised device might change settings or learn network details.
actions: Open the printer administration page from a trusted device.
Set a unique administrator password or PIN.
Install the latest manufacturer firmware.

findings.title: Device name reveals personal information
findings.summary: The sample hostname may reveal the owner's identity to network visitors.
findings.explanation: This fictional observation represents a first name included in a device name visible on the local network.
findings.impact: Small identifying details can make social-engineering attempts more convincing.
actions: Rename the laptop using a neutral label.
Restart it so the new name appears across the network.
Avoid names containing a full name, address, or room number.
